lead.description: observations on many units taken at one time, so each unit contributes a single record

self_checks.title: Five incomes
self_checks.prompt: A snapshot of incomes is 2, 4, 4, 6, and 9. What is the mean, and what is the sample variance with divisor n-1?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 5. The sum of squared deviations is 28, so the sample variance is 28/4 = 7.

self_checks.title: Three units
self_checks.prompt: Values 3, 5, and 7 are measured once each. What are the mean and the range?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 5 and the range is 4. No within-unit change is defined.

overview_sentence: [Cross-sectional data](articles/cross-sectional-data.qmd) are observations on many units taken at one time.
